name: Concord Room
description: Live Concord message room inside Orca (right sidebar or a center tab): shows real agent messages, lets you message present agents, shows handoffs waiting for your Accept, and pulls Jira issues in the way Orca's own Tasks view does.

settings.title: Concord repository root (absolute path)
settings.description: Choose the existing repository/worktree whose local Concord messages to display. Leave blank to fail closed.

settings.title: Your sender id in Concord (optional)
settings.description: How you appear to agents, like human:jim. Leave blank to use human:<your macOS username>.

settings.title: Concord CLI executable
settings.description: Absolute path or command on Orca PATH; never a shell command.

settings.title: Agent names (managed by the room)
settings.description: Click an agent's name in the Concord Room to rename it. Stored here as JSON.

settings.title: Agents removed from the room (managed by the room)
settings.description: Click the x on an agent in the Concord Room to remove it from the room; this only hides it, the agent keeps running. Stored here as a JSON list.

settings.title: Handoff folder (absolute path, optional)
settings.description: Where the local synthetic handoff source and its policy.json live. Blank uses ~/.concord-pilot/handoffs. Handoffs are refused unless policy.json is valid.
